verdict.rationale: Stripe's onramp docs name KYC verification and sanctions screening, stating that Stripe handles all regulatory requirements as merchant of record. That is a single, high-level statement scoped to the onramp only, with no detail on how screening works. missing for 10: documented wallet/address risk screening, travel-rule handling, sanctions-screening detail beyond a one-line mention, compliance coverage for stablecoin payments/payouts/Treasury flows, independent corroboration.
